remarks: Massive, renovated, private, low-maintenance 3000 square foot TOWNHOME available in the lovely Brookside neighborhood. This modern giant townhome is nestled only a couple blocks from Rowayton and a comfortable street over from Brookside Elementary and Brian McMahon Highschool. This modern home boasts 4 generously sized bedrooms, 3 of which have elegant vaulted ceilings. In addition, this home has 2 refreshed full bathrooms and 2 half bathrooms. If you're looking for a home that has a grand eat in kitchen with stainless Samsung appliances, 10ft+ ceilings, transparent gas fireplace, private fenced in yard, second floor laundry, primary bedroom suite with double rainfall shower heads, central vacuum, central air, on demand hot water, freshly redone hardwood floors, and more then look no further! This home checks all the boxes to allow for low maintenance modern living in the very commutable Brookside neighborhood of Norwalk. Unit Available first week of August 2025. Pets are allowed but must be cleared by owner: $50/month.  Applicants MUST have and present the following: 700+ credit score, Proof employment, References, Pay stubs, Background checks (eviction & criminal)  Tenants pay for their own gas and electrical meters along with renters insurance. Tenants responsible for yard maintenance and snow removal. Landlord will pay for water & sewer.
